pr_title: fix: Fix `join_where` incorrectly dropping transformations on RHS of equality expressions
pr_body: * Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/21066 This restores the original code to before https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/20865 with an added clone step, and serves as a proper fix for the original issue at: * https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20831 I had previously misunderstood the cause of the original issue, but I believe I now have the correct understanding of what happened. Here is an illustration to show what was happening in the original issue: Essentially, the bug is an in-place mutation of a `Node` in the `expr_arena` by `collapse_joins`, where the same `Node` was also being referenced by a projection in another place. The previous PR (https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/20865) resolved the above issue by always inserting a new ColumnNode. However, it made the incorrect assumption that the RHS of the equality was always a `col()`, and would drop any extra transformations being applied on the RHS (e.g. `col(A_right) + 1` gets incorrectly turned into `col(A_right)`). The proper fix in this PR is to restore the original logic, with an added deep-clone before the mutation takes place to ensure the underlying `Node` being mutated isn't being referenced by e.g. a `Select {}` IR somewhere else. #### `Arena::::get_mut()` In light of this issue, a quick search across the codebase shows `collapse_joins` as the only place that uses `Arena::get_mut()` on expressions arenas: All other uses are generally with logical plan (LP / IR) arenas. I haven't checked in detail whether they are used properly in those places as we don't seem to have any bugs relating to logical plans being incorrectly mutated.

issue_context.title: Incorrect results from `join_where` - transformations on RHS of equality expressions are dropped
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
left = pl.LazyFrame({"a": [1, 2]})
right = pl.LazyFrame({"a": [1]})

q = left.join_where(right, pl.col("a") == (pl.col("a_right") + 1))

print(q.collect())

# Incorrect result
shape: (1, 2)
┌─────┬─────────┐
│ a   ┆ a_right │
│ --- ┆ ---     │
│ i64 ┆ i64     │
╞═════╪═════════╡
│ 1   ┆ 1       │
└─────┴─────────┘

INNER JOIN:
LEFT PLAN ON: [col("a")]
  DF ["a"]; PROJECT */1 COLUMNS
RIGHT PLAN ON: [col("a")]  <------------------------ + 1 was dropped
  DF ["a"]; PROJECT */1 COLUMNS
END INNER JOIN

# Expected
┌─────┬─────────┐
│ a   ┆ a_right │
│ --- ┆ ---     │
│ i64 ┆ i64     │
╞═════╪═════════╡
│ 2   ┆ 1       │
└─────┴─────────┘

INNER JOIN:
LEFT PLAN ON: [col("a")]
  DF ["a"]; PROJECT */1 COLUMNS
RIGHT PLAN ON: [[(col("a")) + (dyn int: 1)]]
  DF ["a"]; PROJECT */1 COLUMNS
END INNER JOIN

```

```shell

```

### Issue description

* Regression from https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/20865



### Expected behavior

See comments in example

### Installed versions

1.21.0
